title: Request supported one-click unsubscribe only after a user clicks
description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a newsletter reader, I want an Unsubscribe button for authenticated supported messages, so that I can request removal from the reader without automatic ingestion actions or a full mail client.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Request supported one-click unsubscribe only after a user clicks
  Scenario: Explicitly request supported one-click unsubscribe
    Given a message has a verified RFC 8058 one-click HTTPS target and authenticated required headers
    When its authorized reader explicitly clicks Unsubscribe
    Then the supported HTTPS POST is requested with the declared one-click body
    And the reader shows request and result status or a visible failure
    And a successful request is not claimed as proof the sender stopped delivery
  Scenario: Never unsubscribe during ingestion
    Given a newsletter contains confirmation, unsubscribe or other account-action links
    When it is ingested, previewed, indexed or classified without that user click
    Then no subscription or account action is triggered
  Scenario: Use a truthful fallback
    Given authenticated HTTPS one-click support is unavailable
    When the user wants to unsubscribe
    Then a suitable external unsubscribe page can be offered for deliberate user action
    And unsupported or failed requests are not shown as completed unsubscription
    And mailto-only limited outbound support remains an explicit design question
    And no full compose or reply mail client is implied
  Scenario: Pause separately
    Given a newsletter Monitor is paused
    When its status is shown
    Then the status does not claim the sender subscription was canceled
```

New feature planning only. RFC source: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8058 . Implementation design must validate DKIM coverage of both List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post, the HTTPS target and declared List-Unsubscribe=One-Click value. The receiver sends a consented POST without cookies or HTTP authorization context; it must not confuse header authentication with an authenticated browser session. Specify authorization, safe target handling, redirect/failure policy, request/result audit and secret-link privacy before implementation. External fallback remains a user action. No POST, unsubscribe, mailbox connection or outbound mail is performed here.
